subject: Is there a way to write a chunk of latex in markdown

messages.author: 60b6b44a6a058fdb
messages.subject: Is there a way to write a chunk of latex in markdown
parts:
Hi All,

I wanted to generate a complex table in markdown. Then I realized it might be not easy write a complex table in markdown. Since the entire report was written in markdown, I was wondering if there is a way to just include a chunk of Latex code in markdown to generate that table.

Thanks,
Qike

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Is there a way to write a chunk of latex in markdown
parts:
Hi,

If you use the right tool to process markdown, it can accept a rather complete subset of LaTeX; here's a set of examples:
http://rpubs.com/Thell/xtable
